title: Missing the last bus
instructions: İki arkadaş son otobüsü kaçırıyor ve ne yapacaklarını konuşuyor. Seçenekleri ve kararı takip et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Oh no, we've missed the last bus!

script.speaker: a
script.text: Eleven thirty. It's eleven thirty-five now.

script.speaker: b
script.text: We could walk. How far is it?

script.speaker: a
script.text: About an hour, and it's raining.

script.speaker: a
script.text: It's about twenty pounds, but we can share it.

script.speaker: b
script.text: OK, ten pounds each. That's fine. I'll call one now.
